transcript: M: Attention, passengers at Carrow Central. Because of a signal failure near Dunhaven, no trains will run on the Harbor Line this evening.
M: Replacement buses are boarding now on the station forecourt, outside the east exit.
M: The train normally reaches Dunhaven in 30 minutes, but the buses will stop at every station along the way.
M: Some trains still appear on the departure board. The board hasn't caught up yet.
M: Staff in yellow jackets are on the concourse, so please check with them before you go to a platform.
M: Please allow twice the normal travel time for your journey. Your tickets and passes remain valid on the buses.
M: We apologize for the inconvenience, and we will announce when trains are running again.

questions.q: What is the announcement mainly about?

options.A: A temporary disruption to train service
options.B: A fare increase on the Harbor Line
options.C: The opening of a new bus station
options.D: A delay affecting a single train

questions.q: Why does the speaker say, "The board hasn't caught up yet"?

options.A: To report that the screens are being repaired
options.B: To promise that trains will be running again soon
options.C: To ask passengers to wait beside the board
options.D: To warn that the displayed information may be out of date

questions.q: How long will the bus trip to Dunhaven most likely take?

transcript: M: Good morning, this is Dale Fenner with your 7:40 traffic report. Eastgate Bridge is backed up.
M: A delivery truck broke down in the left lane, so only one lane is open each way.
M: Crews first said they would clear the truck by 9:00.
M: But a tow company arrived early, and they now hope to have the bridge fully open by 8:30.
M: Many drivers are turning onto Orchard Road to get around the bridge.
M: But a water main repair there has closed a lane, so it's slow going as well.
M: Tonight's concert will bring heavy traffic near the stadium after 5:00.
M: If you can, leave your car at the Lakeside lot and take the Route 12 bus, which runs every 10 minutes.
M: Rides are free until noon today. I'll be back with another update at 8:15.

questions.q: What does the speaker say about the crews' estimate?

options.A: It has been put off until noon
options.C: It was changed because of the concert
options.D: It has not changed since this morning

questions.q: Why does the speaker mention Orchard Road?

options.A: To warn that another route is also slow
options.B: To recommend a faster way around the bridge
options.C: To explain what caused the bridge delay
options.D: To give directions to the Lakeside lot

questions.q: What does the speaker advise listeners to do?

options.A: Wait for the next report before leaving home
options.B: Take Orchard Road instead of the bridge
options.C: Put off their trips until noon
options.D: Switch to public transportation for part of the trip

transcript: W: Thank you for calling Brightline Internet. Please listen carefully, because our menu options have changed.
W: If you are calling about the outage in the Marlow area, you don't need to stay on the line.
W: Crews expect to restore service by 3:00, and we'll send you a text message when it's done.
W: To report a problem with your connection, press 1. To change or cancel a technician visit, press 2. For billing, press 3.
W: Business customers, press 0.
W: After you choose, you'll be asked to key in your account number, which is at the top of your monthly bill.
W: If you're calling from the phone number on your account, you can skip this step.
W: Our wait time is currently about 10 minutes. If you'd rather not hold, press 9, and we'll call you back within the hour.

questions.q: What is expected to happen by three o'clock?

options.A: A technician will visit customers' homes
options.B: The wait time will drop to ten minutes
options.C: A service problem will be fixed
options.D: Every caller will receive a return call

options.A: Wait for a text message about service

questions.q: What does the speaker offer callers who do not want to hold?

options.A: A chance to be contacted by phone later
options.B: A text message about the outage
options.C: A direct line to the business desk
options.D: A shorter wait for billing questions

transcript: M: Running out of room at home? Cedar Row Storage has the space you need, and it's closer than you think.
M: We rent secure, indoor units by the month, in four sizes, with no long-term contract.
M: Clearing out a two-bedroom apartment? Our second-largest unit holds everything, from the sofa to the last box of books.
M: Most of our customers start with a garage full of boxes. With us, your garage can finally be a garage again.
M: And if you sign up before the end of the month, your first month is half price.
M: Visit us on Mill Street, or reserve a unit online at any hour.
M: Units go quickly, so reserve yours today.

questions.q: Look at the graphic. How much would a new customer who signs up this month pay for the first month of the unit the speaker describes?
Why does the speaker say, "Your garage can finally be a garage again"?

options.A: To say that the company is building new garages
options.B: To offer a service that stores customers' cars
options.C: To suggest that renting a unit will free up space at home
options.D: To explain that the units are cheaper than a garage

transcript: W: Good morning, everyone, and welcome to our customer service workshop. I'm Helen Ford, and I'll be hosting today.
W: You'll find a name badge and a printed schedule in the folder on your chair.
W: Please wear the badge all day, because you'll need it to get into lunch.
W: One change to that schedule: our data presenter is stuck at the airport, so the two afternoon sessions will switch times.
W: Each session keeps its original room, so please check the schedule carefully after lunch.
W: We'd also love your opinions. A short survey will be e-mailed at 4:00, and everyone who completes it by Friday enters a prize drawing.
W: Now, let's begin. Please turn to the person beside you and introduce yourself.

questions.q: Why are listeners asked to wear their badges all day?

options.A: To get a printed schedule at the door
options.C: To be admitted to a meal
options.D: To be matched with a partner for an activity

questions.q: Look at the graphic. In which room will the 1:30 P.M. session now take place?
What can listeners do to enter a prize drawing?

options.A: Give their opinions of the workshop

transcript: W: Welcome to the Alder Lane Roastery, everyone. I'm Marisol, and I'll be your guide for this 45-minute tour.
W: Normally we begin with a tasting, but the tasting room is booked today, so we'll finish there instead.
W: We'll follow the beans from storage to packing. The roasting room is our third stop, and it gets very loud.
W: Before we enter it, please take a pair of earplugs from the basket in the hallway.
W: Please stay behind the yellow line near the machines, since the drums get extremely hot.
W: Photos are welcome, but please turn off your flash. If you'd like to buy beans, our shop will open after the tasting.
W: Before we set off, I need everyone's name on the visitor sheet. It's on the clipboard right here.
W: Once everyone's name is down, we'll head to the storage room.

What change does the speaker mention?

options.A: The tour will begin with a tasting
options.B: The tour will be shorter than usual
options.C: The tasting will come later in the visit than usual
options.D: The roasting room will be closed to visitors
